description: Simplify complicated websites into focused workflows.
notes: Kit fallback inlined; shared kit.js not present at build time

notes.note: Rebuilding hostile checkout pages as focused step wizards is a lovely idea for ADHD and cognitive overload. But a browser extension that rewrites checkout flows is a breakage nightmare — every site update is a support ticket. And 'affiliate-free, trust is the product' is a slogan, not revenue; $5/mo won't cover the maintenance.
Simplify collapses 12 distractions to 4 steps; zero errors.

notes.change: Success receipt gained 'Copy my receipt' (shareable 12→0 distractions receipt text). Fixed the same pre-existing K.nav stacking bug: header was re-inserted on every step transition. Simplify toggle also got data-core for QA.
